caseNameFull: Seibert v. Brownell, Attorney General, Successor to the Alien Property Custodian
attorneys: Morris Lavine for appellants. Solicitor General Rankin, Assistant Attorney General Townsend, James D. Hill, George B. Searls and Irwin A. Seibel for the Attorney General, appellee.

opinions.text:
Per Curiam:

The motion to dismiss is granted and the appeal is dismissed for want of a substantial federal question.
